description: Audit 2026-11-03 (napoleon-remastered docs/audits/AUDIT_2026-11-03.md) R5, R6, R7, R8, R10, rule rows 'never review your own job' and 'earlier review rounds never edited'. policy.py:144-155 compares the report's trailer with the review's only. Add: a round whose own commits change files outside jobs/ must end with the verdict 'merge after fixes', so a fresh round reviews the reviewer's code (J9 2e6a75d, J24 192170c, J46 3d6ed72, J66 08a7a7c and W2's hooks.cpp 649c290 merged unreviewed); each round's trailer differs from the builder's and from every earlier round's (J4, J20 and J52 round 2 were written by the round 1 reviewer); earlier rounds of review.md stay byte-identical on later commits; run ids and evidence a report or review cites resolve on the base branch or a pushed tag (W2 merged on evidence that sits on napoleon's unmerged job/J30, built from an unpushed core commit); a game hook may require a decision row added on job/ to cite the brief that required it; a branch-level review claim that the autopilot reads (jobq.py:523 keys the live guard on session names; J10 had two round 1 reviewers at once); a merge verdict on a large diff that cites no run id or evidence is a warning (J62, J57). R10: jobs/<id>/handback.md holds the builder's own words when a subagent cannot write the report, and the report marks what the orchestrator added. After W23 (policy.py). Also remove W23's bootstrap trigger from ci/policy.yml.in (the pull_request trigger limited to jobs/W23/report.md) once a pull_request_target run of policy is recorded on a later pull request, and cite that run id (W23 report, "After the merge").
title: Review integrity: reviewer code, fresh rounds, append-only rounds, cited evidence
